name: grigori_warrior
description: a Grigori Warrior, a bearded young human clubman: tousled brown hair under a teal headband knotted at the back of the head with its tails hanging behind, a short brown beard, bare tan muscular arms, a teal scarf round the neck, a brown leather vest crossed by straps with a round brass brooch, a brown belt hung with leather pouches, a teal kilt, brown leather boots, a knobbed wooden club studded with brass knobs in his RIGHT hand and a round wooden shield with teal stripes, a brass rim and a brass boss on his LEFT arm
hands: the knobbed club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the knobbed club is lifted beside the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the knobbed club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the knobbed club is level, its heavy end pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the knobbed club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its knobbed end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair and the teal headband tails trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the knobbed club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the knobbed club dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the knobbed club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's knobbed end resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the knobbed club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the knobbed club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round teal-striped shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the knobbed club and the round shield on the ground beside him
